title: Dynamic Model Merging with Multi-Layer Aggregated Routing Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2611.28855v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Dynamic model merging aims to retain the efficiency of a unified model while better preserving task-specific expertise through input-dependent routing at both the task and head levels. However, even the routing components of the state-of-the-art approach remain limited: the task routing is highly sensitive to the choice of routing layer, whereas the head routing relies on simple max-logit competition. To address these limitations, we propose multi-layer aggregated routing evidence (MATE) as a unified mechanism for improving both task and head routing. Specifically, we first introduce a metric to quantify task routing separability across different layers. Empirical analysis of this metric reveals that different layers provide complementary evidence for identifying the tasks relevant to an input. translated_title: 基于多层聚合路由证据的动态模型合并
translated_abstract: 动态模型合并旨在保留统一模型的效率，同时通过在任务级和头级进行依赖输入的路由，更好地保留任务特定的专业知识。然而，即使是当前最先进方法的路由组件也存在局限：任务路由对路由层的选择高度敏感，而头路由则依赖于简单的最大logit竞争。为了解决这些局限，我们提出了多层聚合路由证据（MATE）作为一种统一机制，用于同时改进任务路由和头路由。具体而言，我们首先引入一个度量指标来量化不同层上的任务路由可分性。对该指标的实证分析表明，不同层为识别与输入相关的任务提供了互补的证据。基于这一观察，MATE根据路由可分性选择多个信息丰富的层，并聚合它们的逐层路由证据……
tldr: 该论文提出多层聚合路由证据机制，通过量化并选择多层路由可分性证据进行聚合，统一改进了动态模型合并中任务路由对层选择敏感和头路由过于简单的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Multi-layer Aggregated Routing Evidence (MATE), a unified mechanism that quantifies and aggregates routing evidence from multiple informative layers to improve both task and head routing in dynamic model merging.
